IB 2027 · HL

Unit 2: Systems Control

Theme A1.3 | 2 Weeks

Unit overview

How do machines manage chaos and control the physical world?

This unit covers 3 IB Computer Science sub-topics: A1.3.5, A1.3.6, and A1.3.7.

The focus areas are Multitasking & Resources, Control System components, and Control Systems applications.

Coverage

  • A1.3.5 Multitasking & Resources
  • A1.3.6 Control System components
  • A1.3.7 Control Systems applications

Objectives and outcomes

Code What You Will Learn What You Should Be Able To Do
A1.3.5 Multitasking & Resources Explain OS role in managing multitasking and resource allocation.
A1.3.6 Control System components Describe the use of control system components.
A1.3.7 Control Systems applications Explain use of control systems in real-world applications.
